# Hubtech Limited

> > Hubtech Limited provides comprehensive ICT, networking, telephone, and security solutions across Kenya and East Africa.

Hubtech is an authorized distributor of enterprise networking equipment including Siemon, MikroTik, Ubiquiti, and Yeastar systems. The company specializes in structured cabling, Power over Ethernet (PoE) infrastructure, VoIP telephony, CCTV security systems, access control, and telecommunications tower construction for businesses and hospitality sectors.

## Key Topics

- Siemon structured cabling systems
- MikroTik networking equipment
- Ubiquiti wireless solutions
- Yeastar VoIP PBX systems
- Power over Ethernet (PoE)
- Network infrastructure deployment
- CCTV and security systems
- Access control systems
- Telecommunications masts and towers
- Cat 7 and Cat 7A Ethernet cables
- Hotel telephone systems
- VoIP Quality of Service (QoS)
- Wireless networking and Wi-Fi
- Data center infrastructure
- Kenya and East Africa ICT solutions
